groupingJustification: Staged state is scoped to a single run by construction: the stage key is repository/run/plugin/unit, live staging bookkeeping (_staged[RunKey]) and staged validation (ApplyStagedChanges) are per RunKey, and CompleteIndexRunAsync publishes exactly one run's staged set. Groups are therefore formed per (repository, run) with the group key derived exactly as StageKey derives it (replacement origin fields for stage-replace, command fields for stage-delete). Rows of different runs, repositories or publication generations are never merged; within a group the durable command order is preserved with last-command-wins per stage identity, matching live bookkeeping.
